text:
alex: Morning handoff — I'm on until 10:30 PT. Quick notes:
- Prod: small spike in embedding latency for eu-west-1 around 03:10 UTC (p95 + ~80ms) after the model-quantizer job finished. It recovered after ~7m. Watch embeddings service.
- Deploys: rolling restart of the model-logistics worker pool scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT (canary 2 nodes). If you see sustained 503s, trigger fallback to baseline-small via routing policy.
- Config: bumped kv_cache_ttl to 45s in staging; monitoring will decide promote. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/812
- Action items: monitor cache hit rate, check oncall runbook step 4 if error rate >0.5%.

maria: noted — putting eu-west-1 embed dashboard on my watchlist. pinging infra to confirm the quantizer job left no orphan pods.

jonas: quick Q — which metric best for the cache hit? `redwood.cache.prefix_hit_rate` or `redwood.kv.cache_hit_ratio`?

alex: use `redwood.cache.prefix_hit_rate` primarily, `redwood.kv.cache_hit_ratio` is useful as a secondary signal.

oncall-bot: Scheduled reminder: daily-handoff-check at 07:00 UTC. Ops page: https://ops.company/oncall

jia: tagging @sam for the canary tomorrow — can you confirm toleration/QoS for the 2 canary nodes? :eyes:

sam: confirmed. canary has low-priority QoS + node tolerations. I'll add a quick smoke test: `curl -sS https://staging/api/health | jq .` and `kubectl get pods -n infer -l app=model-logistics`.

maria: FYI CI job `test-embed-stability` is flaky — failing intermittently. don't escalate yet unless it starts failing on main.

alex: small runbook note: if you see >3% 5xx across routing-service for >2m, escalate to oncall-sre and toggle fallback to baseline-small from admin UI.

jonas: ack. also leaving a quick CR ping: PR #1067 (docs) — alex can you review when you have 10m?

alex: will review before 08:30.

sam: leaving shift at 08:00 PT, @maria can you take eu-west watch if spike persists?

maria: Yep, taking it. Added to my watchlist and dashboard alert.

oncall-bot: Bridge opened for pre-dawn watch: https://meet.company/bridge/12345 — join for live handover.

jia: :thumbsup:
